01 / EXPLORE THE MODULES

Find your possibilities.

Explore Moons, one module at a time.

01 / XRAY

Select your targets

See custom blocks from supported plugins and items added by mods.

  • Plugin blocksRecognize custom block models in resource packs.
  • Targets & colorsChoose your targets and set their highlight colors individually.
  • Server profilesSave separate target settings for different servers.

Plugin compatibility depends on block model mappings in the resource pack.

02 / CLICKGUI

Your modules. Your control.

Browse modules in game and adjust the settings to suit you.

  • Quick accessPress Right Shift to open ClickGUI by default.
  • Browse categoriesFind the modules you need, organized by category.
  • Make it yoursToggle modules, adjust parameters and change the interface theme.

03 / CONFIGS

Keep your favorite settings

Save your configuration locally and load it next time.

  • Create a presetEnter a name in Configs and click Create.
  • Save your settingsClick Save to store your current module settings.
  • Switch anytimeSelect a saved configuration and click Load to apply it.

04 / YSM

Find your own look

Give your character a personal style with YSM player models.

  • Add modelsPlace your models in the folder shown on the YSM page.
  • Choose and applyRefresh the list, select a model and click Apply.
  • Back to vanillaClick Use vanilla to restore the default player model.
